notes.title: Voidzone will be releasing November 27th!
notes.content:
The Big News!
Hello, Cleaners! Voidzone will be released on November 27th, which is 11/27/2024. I want to thank everyone who has supported me this far in my goal of releasing Voidzone! 

Reflection
I want to address that, as a game developer, I hate my game. I've grown to get tired of developing it, taken a lot of breaks from it, and almost steered away from it. This fatigue is irritating, and I'm afraid to say most game developers experience this. But I have grown a lot from this experience and would love to keep going.

But putting that aside, this short game is for you. I hope this game will live up to your expectations. I developed this game in 2-3 months (I lost track of time). Thank you for staying with me on Voidzone. By the time I write this message, I am already developing another game I want to pump out on Steam, and this is more of a personal journey, so I hope to see you again.

- Woyboy

notes.title: Voidzone Demo is available to download for Steam Fest!
notes.content:
Thank you!

Hello, Cleaners!

Voidzone launched its demo a few days ago, and it's now available for download! I have already received a lot of feedback from people, and I appreciate it all. Thank you, everyone, for whoever already played my demo and published my game, I hope not to disappoint you with the final product! So please stick with me and I hope to bring you an excellent horror experience. 

What's Next? 

Voidzone is nearly finished and the demo is only showcasing a small portion of the game. The game's release date will be publicized soon and I can guarantee that the game will be released sometime this year in 2024. 

I Need Your Feedback!

I am a solo developer on this project alone so it is very hard for me to get criticism on Voidzone. I do politely ask you to please send me some feedback You can do this anywhere by emailing this to my alternative email: woyboyalt@gmail.com, my discord, YouTube, Twitter, hell you could even leave feedback in this announcement alone. Additionally, this game will also have a giveaway at full release for those who send me feedback. 5 Candidates will be selected to receive the game completely free on full release, I hope you enjoy it!

To summarize the whole thing. The current status of the game is that it's nearly completed. Voidzone will have a giveaway to 5 random candidates, and I need feedback. Again, thank you so much for playing my demo and I hope to see you for further updates. Thank you, Cleaners!

- Woyboy
